queue.title: Pronto Network 将于 10 月份参加 Brakes for Breasts 筹款活动
queue.text:
Pronto Network 将参加 10 月份的 Brakes for Breasts 筹款活动

The Pronto Network will participate in the 2026 Brakes for Breasts fundraiser in October. The program brings independent auto repair shops across the United States together to raise funds for breast cancer vaccine research.

Participating Pronto Network Service Centers will provide customers with free brake pads or shoes. Customers will pay for labor and any additional parts required to complete the brake job.

Participating shops will donate 10% of the brake job to the Cleveland Clinic Breast Cancer Vaccine Research Fund. The donations support The Dr. Tuohy Lab and its breast cancer vaccine research.

The Pronto Network will match donations made by participating Service Centers.

The 2026 fundraiser is supported by Bendix, Bosch, DuraGo, NewTek, PowerStop, ProMax and Wagner.

“We’re excited to bring the Brakes for Breasts fundraiser to a select group of our Service Centers this year,” said Kerri Gulick, director of marketing & communications for The Pronto Network. “Independent repair shops have strong connections to the communities they serve, and this fundraiser gives our network an opportunity to come together to support research that could have a meaningful impact on the future of breast cancer vaccines. We’re grateful to our participating members, service centers, and manufacturer partners for helping us support this important cause.”

Brakes for Breasts supports research by The Dr. Tuohy Lab at Cleveland Clinic. The lab developed a breast cancer vaccine that proved effective in laboratory animals.

Phase 1 clinical trials were completed in 2026. The lab is preparing for Phase 2 in 2027.

Brakes for Breasts brings independent automotive repair businesses together to help fund prevention-focused vaccine research. According to the organization, 100% of the proceeds go directly to Cleveland Clinic for breast cancer vaccine research.

The 2026 effort will serve as a test market for The Pronto Network. The organization will gather feedback from participating Service Centers and evaluate opportunities to expand participation in future years.
